events.title: MMA Tactics Next Fest stream: recorded fights all week
events.summary: All through Steam Next Fest (Oct 19 to 26) this page streams recorded MMA Tactics gameplay. It is not live, just fights on a loop, so you can see how a bout plays out before you try it. What you will see: Full fights from the opening bell, on the feet and on the mat Takedowns, top and bottom position, and 7 submissions with no tap button Building a camp: training, perks, gym upgrades and flying out to recruit The free demo is playable from this store page. The full game launches on Steam Oct 28.

events.title: MMA Tactics demo is in Steam Next Fest, Oct 19 to 26
events.summary: MMA Tactics - Martial Arts is part of Steam Next Fest, Oct 19 to 26! The free demo has been out since Oct 1 and is playable right from this store page. Update 1.08 added full controller support, so you can play the whole demo on a gamepad or Steam Deck. It's turn based MMA management in the style of Battle Brothers. events.title: MMA Tactics demo 1.08: full controller support
events.summary: Demo update 1.08 is live. The big one: you can now play the whole demo on a controller, from naming your gym to the final bell. Controller The D-pad moves between buttons, A selects and B goes back. The right stick moves a cursor for everything else (map pins, cage hexes) and RT clicks. Dropdowns open with A, so you can pick a location, a graphics pack and your fighters on the pad. Renaming your gym opens Steam's on-screen keyboard.
